packageRules.description: The Jinja Dockerfiles start from SONiC images the build makes, not from a registry
The KNE VM module's main.go uses only the standard library, and its Dockerfile fetches its own Go. Updating go.mod would only drift from that Dockerfile

Renovate merges the updates the preset labels automerge: security updates below a major version, except patched modules. It merges on a later run, once every check on the head commit has passed, not only the required ones, and the renovate-approve app has approved the pull request. Reviewers are still assigned, so one that fails reaches them.
